svg.desc: Three graphs of horizontal branch separation against height. At zero phase the cubic contact stays on the axis. Positive phase moves a quadratic touch above it; negative phase moves it below. Hollow rings mark contacts, filled dots mark crossings. The two axis scales differ. Both branches keep moving.
svg.title: A small turn breaks the mirror

cc:Work.dc:title: A small turn breaks the mirror
cc:Work.dc:description: Horizontal separation against height for a cubic mirror contact and its two quadratic unfoldings after phases of plus and minus .001 radians. Each nonzero phase has a crossing and an off-axis touch in this window. Separate axis scales; both branches keep moving.
